extraction.declarations: column-zero named function declaration candidates; overloads retained
extraction.clauses: literal https://tc39.es/ URLs with fragments; references are not normative coverage

mappings.domain: ApplyStringOrNumericBinaryOperator for +, -, *, /, %, ** over undefined, null, Boolean, String, Number and BigInt; serializable primitive conversion, type-check and arithmetic phases.
limitations: No Symbol operands or object-to-primitive coercion.
No guest catch or complete exception propagation.
Primitive arithmetic and scalar string/number conversions use explicitly bounded host leaves.
Partial operation domains; no claim of complete ECMAScript semantics or Test262 execution coverage.
